The wait between the first two seasons of Severance has already been long, and the third season will similarly require great patience, but Apple TV has just brought some noteworthy news about the series' progress.

"Severance" Season 3 Has Officially Started Filming, Expected to Premiere Late 2027

It has been about 18 months since the premiere of Severance Season 2. While the progress of the third season may not be as fast as everyone hoped, it has just reached an important milestone.

According to a post on X by Ben Stiller (reposted by the Apple TV account), Season 3 of Severance has just officially begun filming.

A low-resolution production photo shared by Stiller appears to show Mark S. and Helly R. running down a Lumon corridor—evocative of the imagery from the Season 2 finale.

Season 2 ended with Mark deciding to stay with Helly, going against his "outie"'s original plan to reunite with Gemma, setting up what will undoubtedly be a highly intense chain of events for Season 3.

There was a three-year gap between Severance Seasons 1 and 2, due to factors including script rewrites, reshoots, and the Hollywood strikes.

If Season 3 has a production period of 6 to 9 months, plus another six months of post-production, Severance is very likely to return in fall 2027—just a few months shy of a three-year interval.

When do you expect Severance Season 3 to premiere? Let us know in the comments.
